assets.name: hero
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: ultra-wide photographic header background for a dark survival training progress dashboard. Generate ONE cinematic landscape photograph, panorama aspect ratio 3:1, requested 1920 by 640. A rugged alpine mountain range above layers of misty evergreen forest, a small warm sunrise breaking over the mountains near the right third, cool deep teal forest and blue-grey mountains with subtle amber light. A lone backpacking hiker, fully visible from head to boots, stands on a rocky overlook at 77 percent across the composition, facing the distant mountain sunrise. CRITICAL FRAMING: keep the ENTIRE hiker within the middle vertical 45 percent of the image, between y=27% and y=72%, relatively small in the vast landscape, with generous sky above the head and rocks below the feet; the top and bottom 25 percent may be cropped by a shallow website header. Mountains must remain recognizable through the central horizontal band. Left 40 percent is dark, low contrast forest and atmospheric mountains, providing quiet space for white UI text. Natural detailed editorial outdoor photography, sophisticated dramatic light, realistic rugged backpack and clothing, no facial closeup. No text, lettering, logos, watermark, border, UI, collage, typography, icons or charts.
